description: This file defines classes and methods related to tracking and serializing progress information for Spark Structured Streaming queries, including progress of operators, sources, and sinks during streaming execution.

classes.name: StateOperatorProgress
classes.description: Represents progress information about updates to stateful operators during a streaming query trigger.

classes.name: StreamingQueryProgress
classes.description: Contains progress information for a streaming query during a trigger, including source, sink, and operator metrics.

classes.name: SourceProgress
classes.description: Holds progress details for a streaming source during a query trigger.

classes.name: SinkProgress
classes.description: Contains progress details for a streaming sink during a query trigger.

methods.name: json
methods.description: Returns the JSON string representation of the progress object.

methods.name: prettyJson
methods.description: Returns a pretty-printed JSON string of the progress object.

methods.name: jsonValue
methods.description: Constructs the JSON value representation of the object for serialization.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the pretty JSON string of the object.
